hlg_d5ce2ac12891b4b7_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: The system shall provide visibility into ambulance operations by displaying the real-time geographical location of all active ambulances on a map interface and allowing the Radio Operator to view detailed status information, including current operational state, for a selected ambulance.
hlg_d5ce2ac12891b4b7_001.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to display the real-time geographical location of all active ambulances on a map interface. llg_002 adds the capability for the Radio Operator to view detailed status information for a selected ambulance, specifically its current operational state (e.g., 'en route to scene', 'at scene', 'en route to hospital', 'available').

Voting result 3/3 for KEEP_ORIGINAL_HIGH_LEVEL_GOAL. The original HLG expresses the outcome set {track, monitor} for the exact location and status of moving ambulances. The reconstruction HLG' expresses {display, view} for real-time location and status details. While the domain object (ambulance location/status) and actor (Radio Operator) match, the functional verbs differ: 'track/monitor' implies active surveillance and continuous awareness, whereas 'display/view' describes passive system capabilities. The documentation supports the Radio Operator's role in 'monitoring' movement data, making the original intention valid and distinct from mere display. The reconstruction is a partial overlap because it captures the data visibility aspect but omits the active monitoring/awareness aspect of the original goal. The parent is supported by the documentation ('exact location... must be tracked... radio operators... accurately record'), so it should be kept, but the LLGs need evaluation to ensure they support the 'monitoring' aspect, not just display. Voting result 3/3 for KEEP_LOW_LEVEL_GOALS. The parent HLG requires the Radio Operator to track and monitor the exact location and status of all moving ambulances. llg_001 explicitly supports the 'exact location' requirement by displaying real-time geographical locations on a map. llg_002 explicitly supports the 'status' requirement by allowing the operator to view detailed operational states (e.g., en route, at scene). Both LLGs are directly grounded in the project description's emphasis on tracking location and communicating status. There are no unsupported additions, redundancies, or missing essential capabilities within the scope of this specific HLG. The decomposition is complete and precise.

goals.description: The Dispatcher aims to quickly and effectively assign the most suitable available ambulance to each emergency call to ensure rapid response.

actor.description: Allocates available ambulances to emergency calls and uses the Computer Aided Despatch (CAD) system.

goals.name: Optimize Ambulance Allocation and Tracking for Target Response Times
goals.description: The Dispatcher's primary goal is to strategically allocate available ambulances to emergency calls, leveraging the Computer Aided Despatch (CAD) system to accurately calculate estimated arrival times and continuously track ambulance movements. This ensures that ambulances consistently reach incident scenes within the critical 11-minute target, while also maintaining the overall dispatch process within defined maximum time limits.
